sentences.text: No: for a Tier 3 UCB, the in-force directions say it shall not levy any pre-payment charges on floating-rate business loans to MSEs with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh, and that applies here because the loan is a floating-rate business loan to an MSE for ₹40 lakh sanctioned in March 2026.

There is also an in-force provision stating that pre-payment charges are permitted for loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, but the specific Tier 3 MSE business-loan rule above says not to levy them here.
